summary: Tested two new Save/Load enhancements in Hot Live 95 studio (via license gate bypass). Feature 1 (Single-File Save toggle) and Feature 3 (Import All Parts Warning modal) both pass. No regressions observed.
verified_flows: License gate bypassed via localStorage hotlive95_license; studio loaded; app-logo renders.

Feature 1: single-file-save-toggle present in Sidebar footer. Initial aria-pressed='true'. After click, aria-pressed='false'. After full page reload, aria-pressed remains 'false' — state persists in hotlive95_state settings.

Feature 3: Setting import-playlist-input to part 1 file triggered parts-needed-modal with expected text ('Split Test was saved in 2 parts. You've loaded 1 of 2. Still need part 2.'). All four testids present: parts-needed-browse, parts-needed-input, parts-needed-dismiss, parts-needed-close. Loading part 2 via parts-needed-input closed the modal and 'Split Test' playlist appeared in the sidebar (restored).
Regression: header renders, playlists list works, no console errors observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new enhancements (single-file-save-toggle persistence and parts-needed-modal for multi-part playlist import) work as specified. License gate bypass via localStorage hotlive95_license continues to work.
